question: Identify a substance that is NOT an allotrope of carbon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phosphorus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phosphorus** is not an allotrope of carbon.
 
• Allotropes are different structural forms of the same element, and carbon has several allotropes including **Graphite, Buckminsterfullerene, and Diamond**.
 
• Phosphorus is a different element altogether an
